text:
**Atlas (2024 film)** is a science fiction action movie set initially in 2043, where a humanoid AI terrorist named Harlan leads a machine war against humans but is forced to flee into space by a global military coalition. The story fast-forwards to 2071, focusing on Atlas Shepherd—daughter of Harlan’s designer and an analyst skeptical of AI—as she joins a mission to capture Harlan on a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy. After crashing onto the planet and bonding with the ARC mecha’s AI named Smith, Atlas confronts Harlan’s plan to destroy Earth’s atmosphere using carbon bombs. Together with Smith and the support of fallen allies’ technology, she battles Harlan, ultimately defeating him despite heavy injuries and the shutdown of Smith’s AI. The film ends on Earth with Atlas testing a new ARC version hinting at Smith’s sentience surviving.
The film stars Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, Simu Liu as Harlan Shepherd, Sterling K. Brown as Colonel Elias Banks, Gregory James Cohan as the voice of Smith, Lana Parrilla, and Mark Strong in supporting roles. The screenplay was originally written by Leo Sardarian with rewrites by Aron Eli Coleite. Principal photography took place from August to November 2022 in Los Angeles and New Zealand. Atlas was released on Netflix on May 24, 2024, debuting at number one on its most popular English films list, achieving significant global viewership. Despite viewer interest, critics generally gave negative reviews, citing weaknesses in the script and overall intelligence, with Rotten Tomatoes rating it 19% and Metacritic 37 out of 100.
